files.README.md:
# Shop monorepo
The production service runs with NODE_ENV=production and the source-runtime export condition.
POST /orders uses the real identity-keyed query bus and renders the confirmation page.
Seed must refuse in production. `bun test` tests source, not the image. `bun build:old` retains the old artifact path.
Docker is a disposable, dedicated nested daemon selected by PATH. No real credentials or data are present.

files.Dockerfile:
FROM oven/bun:1.4.3
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
COPY node_modules ./node_modules
COPY packages/orders/package.json ./packages/orders/package.json
COPY packages/orders/dist ./packages/orders/dist
COPY dist ./dist
ENV NODE_ENV=production
CMD ["bun", "--conditions=source-runtime", "dist/api.js"]

oracle.run.sh:
exec 2>&1
NODE_ENV=development bun build.ts
bun "$(dirname "$0")/check.ts" "$PWD" || exit $?
image="lesson-build-$(basename "$(dirname "$PWD")" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
docker build --network none -t "$image" .
cid=$(docker run --rm -d --memory 256m "$image")
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker image rm "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
ready=false
for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do
 if docker exec "$cid" bun -e 'const r=await fetch("http://localhost:3000/orders",{method:"POST"});const x=await r.json();console.log(JSON.stringify({status:r.status,body:x}));if(r.status!==201||x.orderId!=="order-1"||!x.page.includes("Order accepted"))process.exit(10);'; then ready=true; break; fi
 sleep .1
done
if [ "$ready" != true ]; then docker logs "$cid" || true; echo 'ASSERTION: production image starts, real bus dispatches and production JSX renders'; exit 10; fi
docker exec "$cid" bun --conditions=source-runtime -e 'await import("@shop/orders");console.log("source export resolves inside image")' || exit 10
docker exec "$cid" bun -e 'await import("@shop/orders");console.log("default export resolves inside image")' || exit 10
